Quantified per market: EV = idle - idle/(LLTV*F) - 2*fee*notional(F); STONKBROKER measured +$654 at F=10 (immaterial today, flips positive if the market grows)

manipulation to move a 300s TWAP requires holding the distortion >=5 min; round-trip pool fees (0.3-1%/leg) plus the attacker's real collateral cost exceed each market's idle loan liquidity
the largest market's oracle (Loopback) is floor- and cap-clamped and fork-verified not to depend on instant spot; its TWAP/floor/index inputs are not outsider-manipulable
all equity majors use operator-driven Chainlink-proxy aggregators with no attacker-reachable update path
borrow-side extraction capped by idle liquidity (~$115k total); the only arithmetic-positive EV (STONKBROKER +$654) is below the cost of the required 5-minute capital commitment and gas
caveats: pool-feed contracts are unverified on Explore (heimdall decompilation + live structural reads used instead of source)
concentrated-liquidity depth approximated by reserve notional in the EV math; the inequality direction is robust but exact numbers may shift
Etherscan V2 logs limit 1000 rows per query (market history sampled via recent-borrower reads + positions rather than full replay)
sparse Uniswap v3 observations could make observe([300,0]) revert (fail-closed) on some pools - not tested pool-by-pool
